note: Set B is preferred because it avoids the significant dimension parsing errors present in Set A, which incorrectly extracts the pin connection plate thickness as 1/2" and length as 1" (text indicates 1" thickness and 3.5" dimensions). Set A also misbinds the threaded rod to Detail A3 instead of the Footing Detail B1 where the pin connection is located. Set B has fewer factual errors, although it misclassifies a C3X6 channel as an angle and incorrectly associates an angle section with the column cap plate.
